summary: Published Android and Windows distributions from the same clean source revision. Native build identities are synchronized at version 1.0.36+69 / release order 50. Android release contains signed split APKs for arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a and x86_64; Windows release contains the x64 distribution ZIP. The in-app client-update catalog was not changed or promoted.

checks.name: Full Flutter native release gate
checks.observation: All Flutter client tests passed, followed by LiveKit and flutter_webrtc package tests and analyzer. Analyzer reported only non-fatal infos under the configured release gate.

checks.name: Package version regression
checks.observation: Profile version label matches the shared package release version 1.0.36+69.

checks.name: Build identity and release publisher tests
checks.command: python3 -m pytest -q tools/build/test_client_identity.py; node --test tools/release/android/publish.test.mjs tools/release/android/publish_retries.test.mjs tools/release/android/publish_conflicts.test.mjs tools/release/windows/publish.test.mjs
checks.observation: Three client identity tests and nine Android/Windows publisher tests passed; Android, Windows, macOS and iOS identities validate at 1.0.36+69 / r50.

checks.name: Android debug build preflight
checks.observation: Built app-debug.apk locally with the new version identity. This debug APK is not part of the release assets.

checks.name: Local Android Kotlin build-mode preflight
checks.observation: The local host has Java 8 only; the Kotlin mode check requires JDK 17. The hosted Android quality job ran the same check with setup-java@v4 and passed.

checks.name: Hosted Android Release
checks.observation: Both quality/flutter and android-release jobs completed successfully; signed distribution was published.

checks.name: Hosted Windows Release
checks.observation: Windows x64 distribution build and GitHub release publication completed successfully.

limitations: The GitHub release assets are published, but deploy/client-updates/catalog.json remains unchanged; clients will not be offered these builds through the in-app updater until a separate catalog promotion is requested. macOS release remains separate because its workflow requires the unavailable self-hosted macOS runner.
status: PASS — Android and Windows GitHub Releases and all listed assets are published; release quality jobs passed.
